hunts.frontierhunts.whitetail.tagline: Woods and field edges. The rut is everything.
hunts.frontierhunts.whitetail.brief: Whitetails bed in thick cover and feed on field edges at first and last light. Scout with trail cameras, then wait in a stand or blind downwind of a trail. In the rut (October to mid-December) bucks answer grunts, bleats and rattling.
hunts.frontierhunts.whitetail.where: Forests, plains, meadows and river bottoms almost everywhere.
hunts.frontierhunts.whitetail.title: Rut Hunter
journal.frontierhunts.check.hunt_whiteta: Hang a trail camera on a trail, field edge or scrape. Any whitetail it photographs counts.
Take a whitetail with a heart or lung shot, then field-dress it.
Grunt, bleat or rattle a deer in, then take it within 5 minutes. Calls work best in the rut.
Take a buck with 8 points or more.
During the rut, take a buck with 8 points or more from a tree stand or blind, with a heart or lung shot.
hunts.frontierhunts.elk.tagline: High parks and dark timber. Listen for the bugle.
hunts.frontierhunts.elk.brief: Elk live in herds in mountain meadows and timber. Hunters glass open parks at dawn and dusk from far off, then close in on foot. In the rut (late August to mid-October) bulls answer a cow call or a bull grunt and come looking.
hunts.frontierhunts.elk.where: Taiga, meadows, groves and mountain valleys.
hunts.frontierhunts.elk.title: Elk Caller
journal.frontierhunts.check.hunt_elk_gla: Hold binoculars or a rangefinder steady on an elk 100 m or more away.
journal.frontierhunts.check.hunt_elk_cle: Take an elk with a heart or lung shot, then field-dress it.
journal.frontierhunts.check.hunt_elk_cal: Call an elk in with the Doe Bleat Call (a cow call) or the Grunt Tube, then take it within 5 minutes.
journal.frontierhunts.check.hunt_elk_her: Take a bull with 5 points a side or better that weighs 270 kg or more.
journal.frontierhunts.check.hunt_elk_mas: During the rut, take a bull with 5 points a side or better that came to your call, with a heart or lung shot.
hunts.frontierhunts.moose.tagline: Willow bogs and lakeshores. Patience and the cow call.
hunts.frontierhunts.moose.brief: Moose feed in willows, bogs and shallow water, often alone. Hunters move quietly along lakes and creeks, or sit and call. In the rut (September and October) bulls answer a cow call or a bull grunt, sometimes from far away.
hunts.frontierhunts.moose.where: Taiga, swamps, bogs and river bottoms in the north.
hunts.frontierhunts.moose.title: Moose Caller
journal.frontierhunts.check.hunt_moose_s: See a moose clearly from 40 m or closer.
journal.frontierhunts.check.hunt_moose_c: Take a moose with a heart or lung shot, then field-dress it.
Call a moose in with the Doe Bleat Call (a cow call) or the Grunt Tube, then take it within 5 minutes.
journal.frontierhunts.check.hunt_moose_b: Take a bull with 7 points a side or more.
journal.frontierhunts.check.hunt_moose_m: During the rut, call in a bull near water and take him with a heart or lung shot.
hunts.frontierhunts.pronghorn.tagline: Open plains. They see you first.
hunts.frontierhunts.pronghorn.brief: Pronghorn live on open grass and sage and have eyes like strong binoculars. Hunters glass from far away and plan a stalk using every dip in the ground, or sit in a blind near water. Shots are often long.
hunts.frontierhunts.pronghorn.title: Plains Stalker
journal.frontierhunts.check.hunt_prongho: Hold binoculars or a rangefinder steady on a pronghorn 100 m or more away.
Take a pronghorn with a heart or lung shot.
Take a pronghorn while you sit in a ground blind or tower blind.
Take a pronghorn that weighs 54 kg or more.
Glass a pronghorn, stalk it on foot (no stand or blind) and take it from 100 m or more with a heart or lung shot.
hunts.frontierhunts.bison.tagline: Grass country. The herd is watching.
hunts.frontierhunts.bison.brief: Bison graze in herds on open grass. A fair-chase hunt means walking in on foot, using the wind and the land to get close without moving the herd, then one well-placed shot behind the shoulder. A hurt bison may charge.
hunts.frontierhunts.bison.where: Plains, sunflower plains, sagebrush and aspen parkland.
hunts.frontierhunts.bison.title: Plainsman
journal.frontierhunts.check.hunt_bison_g: Glass a bison with at least two more bison near it.
journal.frontierhunts.check.hunt_bison_c: Take a bison with a heart or lung shot.
journal.frontierhunts.check.hunt_bison_f: On foot (no stand, blind or vehicle), take a bison from a herd of three or more before it notices you.
journal.frontierhunts.check.hunt_bison_b: Take a bison that weighs 730 kg or more.
journal.frontierhunts.check.hunt_bison_m: On foot, take an unaware bison from a herd of three or more with one clean shot.
hunts.frontierhunts.boar.brief: Wild hogs root in damp woods and creek bottoms and move mostly at night. Hunters run trail cameras, hunt at dusk and after dark with a light or night optics, and use dogs to trail and bay them.
hunts.frontierhunts.boar.where: Forests, maple woods, alder swamps and cottonwood bottoms.
hunts.frontierhunts.boar.title: Hog Hunter
journal.frontierhunts.check.hunt_boar_ca: Get a wild boar on a trail camera.
journal.frontierhunts.check.hunt_boar_cl: Take a wild boar with a heart or lung shot.
journal.frontierhunts.check.hunt_boar_ni: Take a wild boar between dusk and dawn.
journal.frontierhunts.check.hunt_boar_bi: Take a wild boar that weighs 92 kg or more.
journal.frontierhunts.check.hunt_boar_ma: Between dusk and dawn, take a wild boar your tracking hound trailed or bayed.
hunts.frontierhunts.black_bear.tagline: Thick woods. Bait, wait, be sure.
hunts.frontierhunts.black_bear.brief: Black bears roam thick forest and are shy. Many hunters set a bait pile and watch it from a stand at dusk; others glass slopes and stalk. Take your time: judge the bear and wait for a broadside shot.
hunts.frontierhunts.black_bear.where: Forests, maple and birch woods, mossy groves.
hunts.frontierhunts.black_bear.title: Bear Hunter
journal.frontierhunts.check.hunt_black_b: Get a black bear on a trail camera. A camera on a bait pile works well.
Take a black bear with a heart or lung shot.
Use Bait on the ground to set a bait pile, hunt it from cover, and take a black bear that came to it.
Take a black bear that weighs 130 kg or more.
Take a black bear over your bait with a bow and a heart or lung shot.
hunts.frontierhunts.grizzly.tagline: Avalanche slopes and rivers. Keep your distance.
hunts.frontierhunts.grizzly.brief: Grizzlies range over high meadows, slides and rivers. Hunters glass from far away, stalk with the wind in their face and shoot only when sure. A hurt grizzly may charge - be ready.
hunts.frontierhunts.grizzly.title: Mountain Hunter
journal.frontierhunts.check.hunt_grizzly: Hold binoculars or a rangefinder steady on a grizzly 80 m or more away.
Take a grizzly with a heart or lung shot.
Glass a grizzly, then close in and take it before it notices you.
Take a grizzly that weighs 290 kg or more.
Stop a charging grizzly within 20 m with a heart or lung shot.
hunts.frontierhunts.polar_bear.tagline: Ice and snow. White on white.
hunts.frontierhunts.polar_bear.brief: Polar bears hunt along icy coasts and snowfields. There is nowhere to hide, so hunters glass from far off and close in slowly in white clothing, using drifts and ridges.
hunts.frontierhunts.polar_bear.where: Snowy plains, ice spikes, frozen coasts and peaks.
hunts.frontierhunts.polar_bear.title: Ice Walker
journal.frontierhunts.check.hunt_polar_b: Hold binoculars or a rangefinder steady on a polar bear 80 m or more away.
Take a polar bear with a heart or lung shot.
Take a polar bear while you wear snow ghillie or snow camo clothing.
Take a polar bear that weighs 470 kg or more.
Glass a polar bear, close in wearing snow camo and take it unaware with a heart or lung shot.
hunts.frontierhunts.coyote.brief: Coyotes live wherever there is open country. Sit hidden on a calling stand, blow a predator call that sounds like a hurt rabbit and watch downwind - they circle to smell the call before they come in. Dawn, dusk and night are best.
hunts.frontierhunts.coyote.title: Song Dog Caller
journal.frontierhunts.check.hunt_coyote_: See a coyote clearly from 40 m or closer.
Take a coyote with a heart or lung shot.
Blow the Predator Locator Call and take a coyote that comes to it.
Take a coyote in December, January or February, when the fur is thickest.
Between dusk and dawn, take 3 coyotes that came to your predator call.
hunts.frontierhunts.wolf.tagline: Northern forests. Big country, long shots.
hunts.frontierhunts.wolf.brief: Wolves travel in packs over huge areas of northern forest. Hunters glass open ridges and frozen meadows, use a predator call, and are ready for long shots in winter, when the fur is best.
hunts.frontierhunts.wolf.where: Taiga, snowy forests, groves and highland pines.
hunts.frontierhunts.wolf.title: Timber Wolf Hunter
journal.frontierhunts.check.hunt_wolf_gl: Hold binoculars or a rangefinder steady on a gray wolf 60 m or more away.
journal.frontierhunts.check.hunt_wolf_cl: Take a gray wolf with a heart or lung shot.
journal.frontierhunts.check.hunt_wolf_ca: Blow the Predator Locator Call and take a gray wolf that comes to it.
journal.frontierhunts.check.hunt_wolf_pr: Take a gray wolf in December, January or February.
journal.frontierhunts.check.hunt_wolf_ma: In winter, glass a gray wolf and take it from 100 m or more with a heart or lung shot.
hunts.frontierhunts.cougar.tagline: Rimrock and canyons. A ghost on camera.
hunts.frontierhunts.cougar.brief: Cougars are secretive and mostly seen on trail cameras. The classic hunt follows fresh tracks in snow behind hounds. Here your tracking hound trails a cat by its blood or prints and bays it.
hunts.frontierhunts.cougar.where: Mountains, windswept hills, foothills and canyons.
hunts.frontierhunts.cougar.title: Houndsman
journal.frontierhunts.check.hunt_cougar_: Get a cougar on a trail camera.
Take a cougar with a heart or lung shot.
Take a cougar your tracking hound trailed or bayed. Put the hound on its blood or prints with the Hound Lead.
Take a cougar that weighs 65 kg or more.
Take a cougar standing on snow, with your hound on its trail.
hunts.frontierhunts.panther.tagline: Jungle nights. Wait in the dark.
hunts.frontierhunts.panther.brief: Panthers (black leopards) hunt the jungle at night. The traditional hunt is a bait near a hide or stand, watched quietly at dusk and into the dark, and one careful shot.
hunts.frontierhunts.panther.title: Night Watcher
journal.frontierhunts.check.hunt_panther: Get a panther on a trail camera.
Take a panther with a heart or lung shot.
Between dusk and dawn, take a panther from a tree stand or blind.
Take a panther that weighs 58 kg or more.
Between dusk and dawn, from a stand or blind, take a panther at your bait with a heart or lung shot.
hunts.frontierhunts.lion.brief: Lions live in prides on open savanna. Hunters glass from far off, track and stalk carefully, and must be ready: a hurt lion charges fast and low.
hunts.frontierhunts.lion.title: Savanna Hunter
journal.frontierhunts.check.hunt_lion_gl: Hold binoculars or a rangefinder steady on a lion 80 m or more away.
journal.frontierhunts.check.hunt_lion_cl: Take a lion with a heart or lung shot.
journal.frontierhunts.check.hunt_lion_st: Glass a lion, then close in and take it before it notices you.
journal.frontierhunts.check.hunt_lion_ma: Take a lion that weighs 190 kg or more.
Stop a charging lion within 20 m with a heart or lung shot.
hunts.frontierhunts.cheetah.tagline: Savanna by day. The fastest hunter.
hunts.frontierhunts.cheetah.brief: Cheetahs hunt in daylight on open savanna with a short, explosive sprint. Most people only ever shoot them with a camera - glass them from far off and watch a hunt unfold.
hunts.frontierhunts.cheetah.title: Safari Tracker
journal.frontierhunts.check.hunt_cheetah: In daylight, hold binoculars or a rangefinder steady on a cheetah 80 m or more away.
Get a cheetah on a trail camera.
Glass a cheetah while it stalks, chases or feeds on a kill.
Take a cheetah with a heart or lung shot.
Take a cheetah of 50 kg or more from 100 m or more with a heart or lung shot.
hunts.frontierhunts.grouse.brief: Ruffed grouse hide in young forest and aspen edges and burst into the air at your feet. Upland hunters walk slowly, ready to mount a shotgun and swing through the bird as it flushes.
hunts.frontierhunts.grouse.where: Forests, taiga, aspen woods and heather moors.
hunts.frontierhunts.grouse.title: Wingshooter
journal.frontierhunts.check.hunt_grouse_: Walk the edges until a grouse bursts into the air near you.
Take a grouse in flight. It flushes when it notices you - be quick.
hunts.frontierhunts.duck.tagline: Marshes at first light. Decoys and the call.
hunts.frontierhunts.duck.brief: Mallards feed and rest on marshes, rivers and lakes. Waterfowlers set decoys on the water before dawn, hide nearby, and use a duck call to turn passing ducks toward the spread. Shoot as they drop in or flare.
hunts.frontierhunts.duck.where: Rivers, swamps, marshes, bogs and lakeshores.
hunts.frontierhunts.duck.title: Marsh Master
journal.frontierhunts.check.hunt_duck_se: See a mallard clearly from 40 m or closer.
journal.frontierhunts.check.hunt_duck_sp: Take a mallard within 24 blocks of your decoys, or one that came to your Duck Call.
journal.frontierhunts.check.hunt_duck_ma: Take 4 mallards over your decoys or call in one day.
hunts.frontierhunts.reward.title: Title: %s
hunts.frontierhunts.species.intro: Click a species to open its hunt: how it is hunted, where to find it and five milestones to work through.
hunts.frontierhunts.species.tip_hunt: Hunt: %s of %s milestones · click to open
hunts.frontierhunts.check.open_card: Click to open this hunt on the Species page.
hunts.frontierhunts.card.contract: Season contract: %s (%s) · %s tokens on the Expedition board
hunts.frontierhunts.card.footer: Deer, elk and moose count when you field-dress them; other animals when they fall. Calls, bait, glassing and hounds count for shots within 5-10 minutes. "On foot" means no vehicle, stand or blind.
hunts.frontierhunts.note.migrated: Hunts opened: %s milestones carried over from your earlier hunting.
hunts.frontierhunts.msg.delivered: %s hunt reward(s) waiting for you were added to your pack.
hunts.frontierhunts.msg.bait: Bait pile set · bears, hogs and big cats find it, mostly from dusk to dawn, for about two days. Watch it from cover downwind.
hunts.frontierhunts.msg.duck_call: Duck call · %s decoy(s) in your spread · stay hidden and watch the sky
hunts.frontierhunts.msg.duck_call_nodeco: Duck call · no decoys out - ducks will look for open water near you
hunts.frontierhunts.cmd.status: Hunts: %s of %s milestones · %s of %s species mastered
hunts.frontierhunts.cmd.tested: Fed a field event for %s to %s hunter(s)
hunts.frontierhunts.cmd.reset: Reset the hunt milestones of %s hunter(s)
hunts.frontierhunts.contract.board: %s: species contracts posted now - %s. They change at mid-month and as the seasons turn.
hunts.frontierhunts.contract.board_none: %s: no species contracts posted now. They change at mid-month and as the seasons turn.
hunts.frontierhunts.contract.how.take: Counts each %1$s you take (deer when field-dressed, others when they fall).
hunts.frontierhunts.contract.how.standbl: Counts a %1$s you take while sitting in a tree stand or blind.
hunts.frontierhunts.contract.how.called: Counts a %1$s that came to your call before you took it.
hunts.frontierhunts.contract.how.clean: Counts a %1$s taken with a heart or lung shot.
hunts.frontierhunts.contract.how.long100: Counts a %1$s shot from 100 m or more.
hunts.frontierhunts.contract.how.onfoot: Counts a %1$s taken on foot - no vehicle, stand or blind.
hunts.frontierhunts.contract.how.night: Counts a %1$s taken between dusk and dawn.
hunts.frontierhunts.contract.how.photo: Counts a trail camera photo of a %1$s.
hunts.frontierhunts.assign.how: Hunt anywhere in the Overworld in Survival, after you accept. The hunt must be yours: your call, your bait, your shot.
item.frontierhunts.duck_call.tip1: Use: a hail call heard about 96 blocks away.
item.frontierhunts.duck_call.tip2: Mallards that hear it swing to your decoys, or to open water near you.
